args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and immediately began failing health checks, with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed successfully; service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: All three regions to **v2.3.0** via rollback.
3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2, on-call paged), documenting the failing deploy, the rollback, and the confirmation of recovery — with a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is found.
